quote.text: This space that has been granted to us rushes by so speedily and so swiftly that all save a very few find life at an end just when they are getting ready to live.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that time with your children is as fleeting as life itself; invest in each moment with genuine care and mindfulness.
    • Encourage those you nurture to live with purpose, teaching them that the present is precious and should be filled with meaning rather than delay.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, understand that your opportunity to make a difference is limited—act decisively and with vision while time permits.
    • Inspire your team by modeling urgency and integrity, ensuring that every decision contributes to a legacy of thoughtful and purposeful leadership.
  • Product Management:
    • In the fast-paced world of product management, be ever-mindful of time’s quick passage; leverage agile methodologies to adapt and innovate.
    • Balance the drive for perfection with the need for timely execution, as delaying action may lead to missed opportunities in a rapidly changing market.
